description: The Planner / Decomposer's plan: which workers run, and in what order. The runtime computes its cost from each worker's model price.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what will be delivered.

worker.description: A worker id from the roster you were given.

goal.description: What this worker must deliver in this step.

acceptance.description: How anyone can tell this step is done: an observable check, such as a test that passes, an output, or a behaviour of the page, that the reviewer and later workers can verify.
